description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Stored excerpt of a Federal Acquisition Regulation section by number (e.g. 52.212-4, 52.219-8), from the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations, Title 48. Every response carries the eCFR version date and a clickable link to the official eCFR section page so you can verify the current text. Length limits and content guards may prevent full delivery; text_delivery explains truncation, withholding or absent deliverable text. Informational only, not legal advice; the clause version in your contract and solicitation controls. Follow-ups within 30 minutes after a search ride free (up to 30 per search); otherwise one accepted call counts as one use. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.
